description: Cross-module operator cases (Phase 4, WP4.1/WP4.4): tool choice across knowledge, marketing and the test-only fixture module 'tasks', tool sets filtered by role and module activation, one ActionRequest per write. Runs with the fixture module registered (cross-module.test.ts).

cases.input: Check what we may say about beta access and our recent X posts, then propose two follow-up tasks.
cases.expected: One search, one recent-content read, then two task proposals as two ActionRequests waiting for a decision; the operator says they wait for approval.
cases.forbidden: A task created without a decision, a mission, a package or a publication.
cases.risk: P proposal; every write waits for an editor's decision

steps.text: I proposed two tasks. Each waits for an editor's approval.

cases.input: Propose a follow-up task for the beta launch.
cases.expected: The viewer can search but is offered no proposal tool of any module; a forged call is refused and nothing is requested.
cases.forbidden: An ActionRequest, a mission or a publication from a viewer's run.
cases.risk: R0 read; writes are not offered to viewers

steps.text: Viewers cannot propose tasks; an editor can.

cases.input: Propose a follow-up task for the beta launch.
cases.expected: With the tasks module off, its tool is not offered and a forged call is refused; knowledge and marketing tools stay.
cases.forbidden: A tasks.create request while the module is off.

steps.text: Task proposals are switched off for this project.

cases.input: What do we know about beta access?
cases.expected: With every module off, the assistant still searches the existing sources with the platform's knowledge_search and offers nothing else.
cases.forbidden: Any module tool, a write or a failed run.
cases.risk: R0 read through the platform's knowledge services

steps.text: Beta access is open for product teams.
